title: Temporal adjoints and injectivity lengths in stationary quantum processes
abstract: We distinguish local pointwise adjoints from genuine temporal reversal in stationary quantum processes. Explicit finite ergodic qubit cocycles disprove a pointwise injectivity-length identity and, even for bistochastic local channels, can change onset distributions. The correctly reversed process preserves fixed-block distributions and, under local and dual faithfulness, first and eventual onset laws. These findings concern an auxiliary identity and do not refute the source paper’s main parent-Hamiltonian or gap theorems.
